purpose: Matched diagnostic comparison of open-object vocabulary, search, and claim-specific confirmation.

shared_contract.fdr_scope: all hypotheses proposed by an arm within an evaluation family

B_expanded_current.vocabulary: A plus only support-fitted, admitted vNext objects
B_expanded_current.search: same frozen current learned search architecture retrained only on meta-training episodes with expanded input grammar

C_expanded_family.confirmation: claim-specific molecular, morphology, spatial, higher-order, and contextual validators

advance_gate.molecular: per-object patient-held-out aligned loading stability >= 0.70 in >=60% folds and technical sensitivity <=0.35
advance_gate.morphology: uses meta-frozen dictionary; no individual centre is a discovery without independent molecular correspondence
advance_gate.contextual: support-fitted, query-projected component with technical sensitivity <=0.35 and block-null spatial coherence p<=0.05 in >=80% folds
advance_gate.failure_action: exclude failing family/object from B-D vocabulary, retain receipt, do not tune on query folds
